title: Can Place Flowers
statement: The flowerbed is a row of plots, 1 planted and 0 empty. No two flowers may occupy adjacent plots. Return whether n more flowers can be planted without breaking that rule.
constraints: the existing arrangement already obeys the no-adjacent rule
the plots before the first and after the last count as empty
hints: Sweep left to right and plant the moment a plot is legal. Planting as early as possible never blocks a placement you could otherwise have made.
A plot is legal when it is empty and both neighbours are empty - treating off-the-end as empty, which is what makes the first and last plots plantable.
Remember to actually WRITE the flower into the array as you plant, or the next plot will not see it and you will double-plant adjacent cells. Stop early once you have placed n.

cases.name: two empty plots hold one flower
two empty plots cannot hold two
